cards.name: Dire Undercurrents
cards.oracleText:
Whenever a blue creature you control enters, you may have target player draw a card.
Whenever a black creature you control enters, you may have target player discard a card.

cards.name: Subcontract
cards.oracleText: A person outside the game looks at target opponent's hand and chooses a nonland card from it. That player discards that card.
